data.title: Thai university shares ceramic techniques in Bhutan
data.description: Experts from Silpakorn University have shared knowledge and techniques in the creation of ceramic sculpture at a workshop in Bhutan.

data.title: Thailand’s Wellness Ambitions Threatened by Research ‘Valley of Death’
data.description: Experts warn lack of clinical trial funding stalls medical breakthroughs, as the FDA pledges early support to help researchers reach the market

data.title: 15 passengers injured when van hits parked truck
data.description: KHON KAEN - Fifteen Lao passengers were hurt when their van hit a truck parked on the side of the Mittaphap highway on Sunday evening.

data.title: Online scammers steal B177m in one week
data.description: Online scammers stole more than 177 million baht from victims across Thailand in a single week, with fake shopping and service offers still the most widespread and costly cybercrime, according to the police Anti Cyber-Scam Centre.

data.title: Whales at risk, hungry pelicans: Marine heat wave hits California
data.description: LONG BEACH (UNITED STATES) - On a boat off the coast of California, Sara Lesser gazes wistfully at dozens of dolphins playing in the vessel's wake. This summer, extreme heat is making such a scene increasingly rare.

data.title: 2,000 passengers stranded overnight at Hong Kong airport due to Typhoon Noul
data.description: About 2,000 passengers were stranded overnight at Hong Kong International Airport as Typhoon Noul battered the city, with some dismayed by their disrupted journeys while others complained about hotel room rates that had risen from HK$2,000 (8,600 baht) to HK$3,000 per night.

data.title: With minutes to flee, Spain fire evacuees grab what they can
data.description: VILLAMANTA, Spain - Ordered to flee their homes as wildfires raged nearby, Spanish villagers often only had minutes to seize what they could: most pets were banned and some had no chance to grab their medicine.

data.title: Take 'The Road To The Golden Peninsula' at BACC
data.description: The rich history and multicultural heritage of southern Thailand are presented during "The Road To The Golden Peninsula", which will kick off tomorrow and run until Aug 9, on the Curved Wall, 5th floor of Bangkok Art and Culture Centre, Pathumwan intersection.

data.title: Siam Paragon hosts marine  conservation exhibition
data.description: Everyone is invited to embark on a marine conservation journey during "Young Rak Talay: Sea The Change – Shape A New Ocean With Our Hands", which will take place at Nex Hall, 5th floor of Siam Paragon, Rama I Road, daily from 10am to 8pm, from Wednesday until Aug 12.

data.title: Reclaiming heritage
data.description: Busui Ajaw, a famous Akha artist, is aware that Akha culture is disappearing. She had been thinking about holding an exhibition to showcase and preserve her own culture for years, which led to her latest exhibition "The Preservation Of Fire" on display at Bangkok Kunsthalle.

data.title: Nadech Kugimiya  now on Netflix with  The Debt Collector
data.description: Superstar Nadech Kugimiya returns to small screens with The Debt Collector, a new action thriller film now streaming on Netflix.

data.title: Lucas Museum to display unseen 'Star Wars' pieces, curator says
data.description: SAN DIEGO - The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art -- founded by legendary "Star Wars" creator George Lucas and his wife -- will see previously undisplayed items from the hit sci-fi series after it opens later this year, its curator told AFP.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for July 27
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Yamaguchi dominates Chen, breaks Chinese hearts
data.description: Japanese badminton star Akane Yamaguchi denied home hope Chen Yufei in the women's singles final of the US$2 million BWF China Open yesterday.

data.title: Aussie great McEvoy masters Commonwealth gold, Ramsay-Peaty hatches battle plan to bounce back
data.description: GLASGOW - Australian swimming great Cameron McEvoy blew away the field to win his first individual Commonwealth Games gold in the 50 metres freestyle as England's Adam Ramsay-Peaty bounced back to reach the final of the 50m breaststroke.

data.title: Signal called: NFL camps open amid league-wide QB crisis
data.description: As NFL summer training camps get underway, a bunch of teams have quarterback worries. Here's a look at what each of those ball clubs did in the offseason to quell their QB concerns.

data.title: UK's Burnham to welcome Zelensky in first foreign leader visit
data.description: LONDON - British Prime Minister Andy Burnham will on Monday host Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky as his first foreign leader since taking office a week ago, to underline London's "unwavering support" for Kyiv.

data.title: Iran halts strikes as Trump gives space to talks
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran and the United States held their fire Sunday, handing Gulf shipping and the oil industry a respite from missile strikes as Donald Trump's UN envoy said the president was "giving talks some space".

data.title: Ex-president Hernandez returns to Honduras after Trump pardon
data.description: TEGUCIGALPA - Honduran ex-president Juan Orlando Hernandez returned to his country on Sunday, almost eight months after US President Donald Trump controversially pardoned his 45-year prison sentence for drug trafficking.

data.title: TSD blocks cyber threat after Investor Portal data leak
data.description: Thailand Securities Depository has contained a data leak on its Investor Portal and notified regulators and potentially affected users

data.title: Emerging markets drive global central bank gold buying in May
data.description: World Gold Council data show central banks added 41 tonnes of gold in May, with Poland leading purchases and China extending its buying run.

data.title: Island cracks down on jet skis
data.description: PHUKET: Phuket authorities have taken legal action against eight jet ski operators following a province-wide inspection campaign targeting unlicensed businesses and illegal foreign nominee arrangements.

data.title: Man wanted over attack in Narathiwat
data.description: A court has issued an arrest warrant for a suspect in the deadly Narathiwat checkpoint attack as Defence Minister Lt Gen Adul Boonthumjaroen pledged to bring those responsible to justice.

data.title: Convincing start for Thailand
data.description: Thailand boss Anthony Hudson made clear that squad places will be decided purely on merit, after the seven-time regional champions opened their Asean Hyundai Cup 2026 Group B campaign in style with a comprehensive 5-0 victory over Laos in Vientiane on Saturday.

data.title: Port seal deal for striker Jude in final summer signing
data.description: Port have confirmed the arrival of Thai-English forward Jude Soonsup-Bell, closing out their transfer business ahead of a gruelling 2026-27 season that will see the club compete on five fronts.

data.title: Korean man cuffed over mule accounts
data.description: A South Korean man wanted under an Interpol Red Notice for allegedly supplying mule accounts to a call-centre gang has been arrested in Bangkok.

data.title: Witnesses lift lid on Senate vote claims
data.description: The opposition on Thursday presented new witness testimony alleging that last year's Senate election was rigged through a coordinated scheme in which candidates were recruited, instructed how to vote and offered payments.

data.title: Thais reject munitions claim
data.description: Thailand has rejected Cambodian claims that its military left nearly 3,900 square kilometres of border areas contaminated with unexploded cluster munitions, saying the figures were unverified and lacked independent forensic evidence.
